## 4E No water coming in - the fill timed out
No water coming in - the fill timed out.
Also shown as: 4E1, 4C, 4C1, NF
1. Check the tap is open, the inlet hose is not kinked and its filter is not blocked.
2. In winter check the hose and tap are not frozen.
3. Then press Start/Pause to carry on.

## 4E2 Incoming water is too hot for the fabric
Incoming water is too hot for the fabric.
Also shown as: 4C2, NF1
1. Check the cold and hot inlet hoses are not swapped, then press Start/Pause.

## 5E The water is not draining
The water is not draining.
Also shown as: 5C
1. Clean the drain filter and check the drain hose is not blocked, kinked or frozen.
2. Then press Start/Pause.

## UE The load is unbalanced, so it will not spin
The load is unbalanced, so it will not spin.
Also shown as: UB
1. Redistribute the laundry, or add a little more if the drum is nearly empty, then press Start/Pause.
2. Waterproof items cause this too - they trap water on one side.

## UB1 Waterproof items in the drum, so it will not spin
Waterproof items in the drum, so it will not spin.
1. Take them out: water cannot escape through them, so they stay on one side and the drum cannot balance.

## DS The door is open
The door is open.
Also shown as: DE, DC
1. Close it firmly, then press Start/Pause if the cycle does not carry on by itself.

## DDC The AddWash door is open
The AddWash door is open.
1. Close it, then press Start/Pause.

## DC4 The inner door is open
The inner door is open.
1. Close it firmly, then press Start/Pause.
2. If it keeps reporting this, it needs a service visit.

## SDE The automatic detergent drawer is open
The automatic detergent drawer is open.
Also shown as: SDC
1. Close the detergent compartment.

## CL Child lock is on
Child lock is on.
1. Switch it off at the panel.
2. Nothing can be started or cancelled while it is on.

## NC The lint filter is missing
The lint filter is missing.
1. Put it back in its slot.

## NC2 The heat exchanger filter is missing
The heat exchanger filter is missing.
1. Put it back in its slot.

## LE A water leak was detected
A water leak was detected.
Also shown as: LC, LE1, LC1
1. Check around the drain filter and the hoses.
2. Switch off and on after 2-3 minutes and try again; if it returns, it needs a service visit.

## OE Overfilling - water kept coming in
Overfilling - water kept coming in.
Also shown as: OF, OC
1. Close the tap and call service.
2. Do not run it in this state.

## CE The drum or the water is too hot for the next step
The drum or the water is too hot for the next step.
Also shown as: CC
1. Check the cold and hot inlet hoses are not swapped, then press Start/Pause.

## E2 A button is stuck
A button is stuck.
Also shown as: BE2, C2, BC2
1. Check nothing is resting on the panel, then switch off and on.

## 2E Mains supply out of range
Mains supply out of range.
Also shown as: 2C, UC, 9E1, 9E2, 9C1, 9C2
1. Check the appliance is switched on at the socket and the supply is steady.
2. If it persists, it needs a service visit.

## AE4 The Wi-Fi module is not answering the appliance
The Wi-Fi module is not answering the appliance.
Also shown as: AC4
1. A network problem rather than a wash problem.
2. Switch off and on after 2-3 minutes.

## 4E3 Diverter valve or cooling fan
Diverter valve or cooling fan.
Also shown as: 4C3
1. This can happen below -10 C: leave it at room temperature for half an hour and try again.
2. Otherwise it needs a service visit.

## 1E Water level sensor
Water level sensor.
Also shown as: 1C
1. Nothing to do at home beyond one power cycle: switch off, wait 2-3 minutes, switch on and try again.
2. If it comes back, it needs a service visit.

## DrumClean Time to run the Drum Clean programme
Time to run the Drum Clean programme.
1. Run it on an empty drum.
2. The appliance counts washes and asks about every 40.

## FilterAlarm Water is left in the drain filter
Water is left in the drain filter.
1. Open the flap at the bottom front and drain it, then clean the filter.

## FreezeProtection Freezing risk - it is near 2 C where the appliance stands
Freezing risk - it is near 2 C where the appliance stands.
1. Empty the hoses and the residual water hose if it will stand unused, or run the appliance's own anti-freezing mode.

## AirwashWarning The chosen programme cannot run with water in the drum
The chosen programme cannot run with water in the drum.
1. Drain it first, then start the programme again.

## DispenserOpen The detergent drawer is open
The detergent drawer is open.
1. Close it.

## DispenserAbnormal The automatic dispenser is not working as expected
The automatic dispenser is not working as expected.
1. Check it is clean and not empty.
2. If it persists, it needs a service visit.

## HotWarning The appliance raised its hot warning
The appliance raised its hot warning.
1. It clears itself.
2. The app carries no explanation for this one, so treat it as information: something inside is hot.
